description: We are CSE students passionate about space technology, software development, and innovation. Our project, AstroHealth, aims to develop a software solution to monitor astronaut health during space missions. We welcome teammates interested in Python, web development, AI/ML, UI/UX design, and data analysis. Beginners eager to learn, share ideas, and collaborate are welcome to join us!
summary:
ASTRA CARE – Intelligent Astronaut Health Monitoring System

ASTRA CARE is an intelligent health-monitoring software solution designed to help astronauts maintain their physical well-being during space missions. It provides a centralized platform to monitor important health indicators, track changes over time, and support informed health decisions in challenging space environments.

The system includes a personalized health dashboard, dynamic charts for visualizing health trends, and a color-coded alert system to identify normal, warning, and critical health conditions. It also provides scheduled reminders for health measurements and daily wellness activities, along with simple explanations to help astronauts understand their health indicators and potential risks. A gamification system encourages consistent participation through achievements, points, and progress tracking.

ASTRA CARE aims to make health monitoring simple, accessible, and engaging, helping astronauts recognize potential health concerns early and take appropriate action. It supports safer, healthier, and more sustainable human exploration of space.
details: Our project focuses on developing a software-based Astronaut Health Monitoring System designed to support astronauts during long-duration space missions. The system aims to monitor and visualize important health indicators through a user-friendly web application, helping identify potential health risks and supporting timely medical decisions. The application provides a centralized dashboard to display astronaut health information, such as heart rate, oxygen levels, body temperature, sleep patterns, and other relevant health parameters. It helps track changes in health conditions and makes the information easier to understand through visual charts and alerts. The main benefit of this project is to improve astronaut health monitoring, enhance safety, and support early identification of possible health problems, especially when astronauts are far away from Earth and immediate medical assistance is limited. We plan to develop the system using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for the frontend and Python for backend processing. Data visualization techniques will help present health information clearly. The project is designed as a software-based solution without requiring additional hardware. The creative aspect of our project is its focus on combining health data monitoring, visualization, and potential intelligent analysis into a single platform specifically designed for the challenges of space exploration. Our team considered factors such as astronaut safety, reliability, simplicity, accessibility, real-time information presentation, and the difficulties of providing medical support during long-duration space missions. Ultimately, our goal is to contribute to safer and healthier human space exploration.
